newsitem.title: GERMANY: Higher German beet deliveries seen in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Higher German beet deliveries seen in 1996/97.

text.p: German sugar industry association WVZ said in its first and second beet delivery reports of the 1996/97 campaign its forecast for total deliveries was 26.43 million tonnes, up from a final 26.05 million in 95/96.

The two reports were issued simultaneously because of late availability of data after the fifth beet test, said WVZ, which will run delivery updates from now until the end of the campaign in January on a weekly basis.
Deliveries to refineries on Oct 4 were 4.03 million tonnes versus 3.27 million recorded at the same time last year and versus 2.67 million recorded on Sept 30, 1996.
Sugar content at delivery on Oct 4 was 17.64 percent, up from 16.29 percent a year earlier and 17.55 on Sept 30.
